note: These are consensus ranges for an OPEN/unconfined domain (low blockage ratio, uniform far-field velocity) -- not the DFG/Schafer-Turek 'flow around a cylinder' benchmark, whose Cd/Cl/St numbers come from a narrow channel with a parabolic inlet profile and a different Re definition. Don't cross-compare the two. Tolerances are generous because the literature itself spans a range depending on domain size/discretization, not because of a single 'authoritative' number.

measurement.transient: Discard at least the first ~40 D/U0 time units (impulsive/seeded-flow startup transient) before sampling -- shedding needs several cycles to reach a stable limit cycle.
measurement.cd_definition: Cd = 2*Fx / (rho0 * U0^2 * D), time-averaged over an integer number of shedding periods (rho0 = 1 in lattice units).
measurement.st_definition: St = fs * D / U0, where fs is the vortex-shedding frequency (estimate via zero-crossing period of Cl(t), or an FFT peak, over the same measurement window).

cases.source: Dennis & Chang (1970), J. Fluid Mech. 42(3):471-489; recirculation length corroborated experimentally by Coutanceau & Bouard (1977), J. Fluid Mech. 79(2).

Braza, Chassaing & Ha Minh (1986), J. Fluid Mech. 165:79-130; He & Doolen (1997), J. Comput. Phys. 134(2) (LBM-specific); Williamson (1996), Annu. Rev. Fluid Mech. 28, St-Re correlation for the laminar shedding regime.
